name: Kolderka
source: "Kolderka" is a short visual-novel game kept in the atmosphere of winter-time melancholy. Get to know the story of a young girl, Katy, who, after a long separation, decides to see her friend once again. Will the boy turn out to be the same as remembered by Katy? What does the fate have in store for the girl? What is her secret? Play now and unravel the mystery.
translation: “Kolderka”是一款充满冬日忧郁气氛的视觉小说短游戏。了解年轻女孩凯蒂的故事，她在长期分离后决定再次见到她的朋友。这个男孩最终会和凯蒂记忆中的一样吗？女孩的命运又会怎样呢？她的秘密是什么？现在就来玩并揭开谜团吧。
